title: Lu Zhishen the Tattooed Monk
content_zh:
Lu Da was a garrison major with a fierce temper and a righteous heart. When he saw a butcher named Butcher Zheng bullying a helpless girl and her father, he killed the butcher with three bare-fisted blows to the face.
Fleeing the law, Lu Da took refuge in a Buddhist monastery, where the abbot shaved his head and gave him the Dharma name Zhishen — 'Profound Wisdom.' He was anything but. His drink and brawls made him the terror of the monastery.
But when the bandits of Mount Twin Dragons threatened a village, Lu Zhishen went alone to confront them. With his iron staff and his roar that echoed across the valleys, he scattered them like autumn leaves.
He was one of the first to join the outlaws of Liangshan. His tattoos — nine dragons coiled from shoulder to wrist — became his mark. Men knew him by the ink before they knew him by name.
